cefrAlignment: Covers B2 spoken production and interaction across Part 1, Part 2 and Part 3, with models at band 6-7 level; self-assessment uses band 6 and 7, consistent with exams.ts's B2 mapping.
examFidelity: IELTS Part 1 (20-30 s), Part 2 (60/120 s), Part 3 (45-60 s), TOEFL interview (0/45 s) and TOEIC Express an opinion (45/60 s) all match exams.ts; the band 6 and 7 quotations were checked against the public IELTS Speaking band descriptors and are accurate.
fixes: Format MCQ Q2 and Q3: rewrote distractors so the correct answer is no longer the only long, qualified option

Fixed four target phrases that were not in the model answers or contained ellipses that the app's phrase matcher can never match (it never feels like, made a big difference, if he'd slipped and fallen, partly about)
Removed the repeated 'fairly' in the Part 1 model
Part 1 heading: clarified that the real Part 1 lasts 4-5 minutes but this mock uses five questions
learnerOutcome: Can sit a full timed B2 speaking mock across IELTS, TOEFL and TOEIC formats and rate their own recordings against the band 6 and 7 descriptors.
